name: Obsidian

1.how: The vault is a folder of Markdown files. Read and write them directly; Obsidian reloads. Frontmatter is YAML; links are [[wikilinks]].
1.notes: This is the whole API for most tasks.

3.how: Electron; tree appears with --force-renderer-accessibility (MausOS sets it in ~/.config/electron-flags.conf for the Arch package; the AppImage/Flatpak need the env var ELECTRON_ENABLE_ACCESSIBILITY or the flag).

quirks: Write notes as files; do not type into the editor.
